content.comment_body: Hello, I have two outputs, let's call them Output 1 and Output 2. I want to switch between them every 5 minutes: Output 1 turns on and Output 2 turns off, then 5 minutes later Output 1 turns off and Output 2 turns on, repeating this process for an hour. Does anyone have an example for this type of alternating control? Thank you! [user_name]
Thank you! That was very helpful.
